title: 第566章 擂鼓点将李靖暴怒第565章 惊雷起小丑竟是我自己
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
“奴才说，崔勇为了让自己活命，主动向陛下献出了李青幽！”
腾！
听到管家确定的话语。
李靖猛地站起身，身上散发出了滔天的杀意。
李青幽是他最疼爱的女儿！
当初被崔勇那个小子忽悠走，他便是气得大病了一场。
原本今天周伯通请他过来，帮他跟崔勇之间缓和矛盾，他其实还是蛮开心的！
毕竟，哪有做父母的总是跟孩子较劲？
但让他万万没有想到的是，崔勇的一切全都是他装出来的！
甚至还他娘的敢把他李靖的女儿，当成礼物送给其他的男人！
这等行为，真真是该死啊！！！
“周伯通，这就是你教出来的弟子吗？！”
“就这样的行为，你还敢帮他说情，你是觉得我李靖没脾气吗？”
周伯通显然也清楚，崔勇的事情若是真的，到底有大。
但崔勇很小的时候，就跟他学习了。
周伯通觉得，崔勇是什么人，他应该比任何人还要清楚！
所以，觉得管家有可能是在造谣的周伯通，并没有立刻回答李靖的质问。
而是一脸阴沉的冲着管家厉声质问：“你这狗东西，可知道在我大周造谣，是何等的下场？”
“我重新给你一次组织语言的机会，说清楚到底是怎么回事？！”
“如若不然，别怪老夫我发飙，不念及旧情！”

管家：“……”
他觉得他好累呀！
他说的明明都是实话。
为啥周伯通就是不相信他呢？
于是乎，也是来了点脾气的管家，此刻也不管李靖会不会发飙了。
当场豁出去道：“宰相大人若是不相信奴才的话，您也可以出去听听看，现在大街小巷全在说这事！”
“而且宫内也的确有人传出消息，亲眼见到九千岁带着李青幽进入了陛下的寝宫！”
轰！
当周伯通听说，大街小巷都在谈论此事，不仅身体气得有些站不稳。
说话的声音，都颤抖了：“怎么会这样，怎么会这样？！”
“崔勇那个小畜生，他怎么能做出这种下三滥的事情？”
content_en:
"My servant said that Cui Yong took the initiative to sacrifice Li Qingyou to His Majesty in order to save his own life!"
Teng!
Hear the steward's words of certainty.
Li Jing stood up suddenly, exuding overwhelming murderous intent.
Li Qingyou is his most beloved daughter!
When he was deceived by that boy Cui Yong, he was so angry that he became seriously ill.
Originally, Zhou Botong invited him over today to help ease the conflict between him and Cui Yong. He was actually quite happy!
After all, what parent is always at odds with their children?
But what he never expected was that everything about Cui Yong was all pretended by him!
He even dared to give his Li Jing's daughter as a gift to other men!
This kind of behavior is really damnable! ! !
"Zhou Botong, is this the disciple you taught?!"
"With such behavior, you still dare to intercede for him. Do you think I, Li Jing, have no temper?"
Zhou Botong obviously also knows how serious Cui Yong's story is if it is true.
But Cui Yong learned from him when he was very young.
Zhou Botong felt that he should know better than anyone who Cui Yong is!
Therefore, Zhou Botong, who felt that the housekeeper might be spreading rumors, did not immediately answer Li Jing's question.
Instead, he asked the housekeeper sternly with a gloomy face: "You bitch, do you know what will happen if you spread rumors in my country?"
"I'll give you another chance to organize your words and explain clearly what's going on?!"
"If not, don't blame me for getting mad and not thinking about my old relationship!"
Butler: "..."
He feels so tired!
What he said was obviously the truth.
Why didn't Zhou Botong believe him?
As a result, the housekeeper also had a temper. At this moment, he didn't care whether Li Jing would get angry or not.
He risked his life on the spot and said: "If the prime minister doesn't believe me, you can go out and listen. Now everyone is talking about this in the streets and alleys!"
"And someone in the palace did spread the news that he saw Jiu Qiansui and Li Qingyou entering His Majesty's palace with his own eyes!"
Boom!
When Zhou Botong heard that people were talking about it in the streets and alleys, he was so angry that he couldn't stand still.
His voice trembled as he spoke: "How could this happen? How could this happen?!"
"That little beast Cui Yong, how could he do such a vile thing?"
